title: Boundless Ores
description: Ores are everywhere at any height
body:
Boundless Ores makes all minecraft ores abundant and they are generated at any height it also works with other modded ores and is configurable, It's great for fast paced or demanding resources modpacks.

You can use this mod in your modpack.

ps. older versions for this mod doesn't work with other modded ores and config
